senses.gloss: to join, be connected, v. Piel, a. לְוָיָה.
(cmp. Sm. Ant. s. v. Nexum) to assume an obligation; to borrow.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 41b">Shebu. 41ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 88a:10">Keth. 88ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 6a:6">B. Bath. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>האומר לא לָוִיתִי וכ׳</he> he who (being sued for a loan duly testified by witnesses) says, ‘I have not contracted any loan’, is considered as admitting that he has not paid.
<cite ref="Chullin 84a:22">Ḥull. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>כגון אנו לווִֹין אוכלין</he> (delicate persons) like ourselves may buy food on credit.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 72b:15">B. Mets. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לווִֹין על שער וכ׳</he> (also <he>לוִֹין</he>) you must not borrow money with the choice of repaying in grain at the present price; (another defin., v. Rashi a. l.).
Bets. 15ᵇ לְווּ עלי make a loan on my (the Lord’s) account; a. v. fr.—Esp. לווֶֹה, לוֶֹה debtor, opp. to מַלְוֶה creditor.
<cite ref="Shevuot 47a:7">Shebu. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>מת ל׳ בחיי מ׳</he> if the debtor died before the creditor; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לווִֹין</he>.
<cite ref="Shevuot 47b:11">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>שני מלווין ושני ל׳</he> two (different) creditors and two debtors.

senses.gloss: to order an escort for protection, v. לְוָיָה. Tanḥ. Bal. 12; Num. R. s. 20 ל׳ להם ענני וכ׳ He appointed the clouds of glory to escort them.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 46b:14">Sot. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>בשביל … של׳ פרעה וכ׳</he> for the sake of the four steps which Pharaoh ordered his men to escort Abraham &c.

senses.gloss: to escort, to walk a distance with a departing guest; to follow.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 119b:5">Sabb. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>שני מה״ש מְלַוִּין לו וכ׳</he> two ministering angels escort man to his house on the Sabbath eve. Sot. l. c. <he>כל שאינו מְלַוֶּה ומִתְלַוֶּה וכ׳</he> whoever omits to escort a guest or (as a guest) declines an escort, is regarded as if he had shed blood; <he>שאילמלא לִיוּוּהוּ וכ׳</he> for if the men of Jericho had escorted Elisha &c.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:17:1">Koh. R. to V, 17</cite> <he>ומה מְלַוֵּהוּ וכ׳</he> and what does escort him (to the grave)? Merits and good deeds; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to join the company of, to associate.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 104">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 26</cite> (play on <cite ref="L00262"><he>לויתן</he></cite>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 104">ib.</cite>) <he>כל מי שמִתְלַוֶּה עמהן עתיד להיעשות וכ׳</he> whosoever joins them (the Romans) will be made sport of with them in future days.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 104">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מי שמתלוה עמהן עתיד הקב״ה וכ׳</he> him who joins them (the scholars), the Lord will cause to rejoice with them &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 862:26">Yalk. ib. 862</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:14">Gen. R. s. 63</cite>, end; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 111:4">Yalk. ib. 111</cite> <he>שנתלוה עמו קלונו וכ׳</he> the disgrace of starvation was made his companion. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 3 <he>להִתְלַוּוֹת לו</he> to be his escort; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be escorted, to accept escort. Sot. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Berakhot 18a:12">Ber. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>ואם הִלְוָהוּ</he> if he does escort him (the dead).

senses.gloss: to lend. EX. R. s. 31 מַלְוֶה ברבית lends on interest; מ׳ שלא ברבית without interest. Ib. שלא יַלְווּ וכ׳ that they must not lend &c. Ib. ראו כמה הִלְוֵיתִי ואיני … ומה הִלְוְותָה הארץ וכ׳ see how much I lend (to man,) without taking interest, and what the earth lends &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:1">B. Mets. V, 1</cite> <he>המלוה סלע בחמשה וכ׳</he> he who lends a Sela to get five Denars in return.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 62b:9">Ib. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>הַלְוֵינִי מנה</he> lend me a Maneh.—
B. Kam. 94ᵇ מַלְיֵי רבית (a. ברבית) those who lend on interest; B. Mets. 62ᵃ; a. fr.—מַלְוֶה creditor, v. supra.
